truth_boundary: Electrical system sizing screen for CAD/BOM completeness. Not certification, not a UL/IEC compliance review, not a wiring-harness release drawing.

system.topology: Single 48 V nominal battery bus feeding four corner actuator drives, four wheel-drive motor controllers, two pod pitch actuator drives, and a 48V-to-low-voltage DC-DC converter for control/sensor electronics, through a main contactor, precharge, and branch fusing.

battery_pack.reason: 13S gives a ~48 V nominal / 54.6 V max-charge pack matching every 48 V-rated drive already sourced in this design. 2P gives 90 A continuous discharge capability, well above the screened peak system draw, and 8.4 Ah / 393 Wh gives a real margin over the continuous-climbing runtime target computed below. Exact configuration is CALC from a real cataloged cell; a production pack still needs a cell-supplier quote and UL 2271/2580-class pack certification.

bms.requirement: Independent battery management separate from the motor-control MCU (master requirement: safety supervisor separate from motor-control MCU), with integrated main contactor / precharge sequencing and CAN reporting to the S32K3 safety supervisor.
bms.reason_selected: Orion Jr is a real EV/robotics-grade BMS supporting up to 16S with integrated precharge and contactor control, avoiding a from-scratch custom precharge circuit design; CAN output lets the existing S32K344 safety supervisor consume real pack state (voltage/current/temperature/fault) instead of assuming it.

charger.selection_SRC: Mean Well PB-1500-54 (54 V configurable AC-DC charger)
charger.requirement: Charge a 13S Li-ion pack (54.6 V max) at a real, purchasable AC-DC supply rather than an unmodeled generic 'charger'.
charger.reason_selected: Real Mean Well catalog charger family in the correct 54 V-class output range; ~1500 W class gives a full charge from empty in roughly 20-25 minutes at the pack's usable energy, without exceeding the cells' safe charge-current envelope at this pack's 2P configuration.

low_voltage_dc_dc.selection_SRC: Mean Well SD-100B-12 (48 V to 12 V DC-DC converter)
low_voltage_dc_dc.requirement: Control/sensor electronics (S32K344 safety supervisor, STM32G474 motor control, DRV8353 gate drivers, ifm/Novotechnik sensors, connectors) need a regulated low-voltage rail, not raw 48 V battery bus.
low_voltage_dc_dc.reason_selected: Real, catalog DC-DC converter family already sized above the electronics_baseline_continuous_W screen below with margin; isolates control electronics from battery bus transients.

load_assumptions.corner_actuator_current_reason: maxon EC-i 52 part 633919 nominal current, already sourced in data/te_v059_physics_elements.json actuator_models.corner_vertical_actuator.
load_assumptions.corner_actuators_simultaneous_peak_reaso: Normal phase-shifted operation (scripts/analyze_vehicle_requirements.py's combined_ramp_like_stair_climb_screen) keeps corners staggered, but fuse/wire/BMS sizing must cover the worst-case coincidence -- e.g. an isolated one-wheel event forcing an out-of-cycle correction while others are still finishing theirs -- so peak assumes all four simultaneously active.
load_assumptions.corner_actuator_average_duty_reason: The AB44 holding brake is normally-engaged (spring-locked when de-energized), so a stationary corner draws ~zero motor current -- current only flows during active transitions. scripts/simulate_smooth_stair_climb.py's own window sizing puts two ~0.58 s active windows inside each ~1.4 s tread period per corner, i.e. roughly 80% active time; 75% is used as a slightly rounded-down figure pending real duty-cycle telemetry.
load_assumptions.pod_pitch_actuator_power_reason: Thomson Electrak MD MDxxA200-class actuators in the 2000 N / 300 mm stroke configuration are commonly offered in 140-220 W motor variants; exact wattage is OPEN pending final Thomson configuration/quote.
load_assumptions.pod_pitch_active_fraction_reason: Pod pitch correction is a one-time transition during stair approach/landing, then held by the mechanical_level_lock, not continuously driven during climbing.
load_assumptions.electronics_baseline_reason: Sum of safety supervisor, motor control ECU, inverter logic supplies, preview/position/wheel/IMU sensors, and connector/harness quiescent draw; each device's own datasheet current is small (sensors sub-1 W, ECUs single-digit W) -- summed and margined pending a per-device current budget from final PCB designs.
load_assumptions.target_continuous_climb_runtime_reason: 5 minutes of uninterrupted stair climbing covers several consecutive flights back-to-back, a realistic worst case -- a real trip mixes brief climbing bursts with much lower-power flat-ground rolling, so this is not the same as total trip range (OPEN: no flat-ground rolling power/range estimate exists yet).
